title.en: The Electric 10 Series Order Has a Horizontal Cell and No Vertical Cell
title.zh: 电动10系列的订单有水平格、没有垂直格

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the Electric 10 Series at 15 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.1 m³, horizontal 25 m, aggregate 2 cm and below, 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm and 400 kg. No vertical distance is printed.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动10系列印成 15 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.1 m³、水平 25 m、骨料 2 cm 及以下、1800 × 800 × 1200 mm、400 kg。没有印垂直距离。

h1.en: Order the Electric 10 Series Without Inventing a Vertical Metre
h1.zh: 订电动10系列时不要编造垂直米数

directAnswer.en: The Electric 10 Series order at Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai stops at the horizontal cell: 25 m. The rest of the printed line is 15 kW, theoretical output 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.1 m³, aggregate 2 cm and below, 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm and 400 kg. The name “10” is lower than the output. There is no vertical figure to attach. If your measured vertical rise has to be written, send it as a site fact and let Xingtai say whether this page still applies. Inquire at [/en/contact/](/en/contact/) with the path. No price is printed.
directAnswer.zh: 在河北品锦机械（邢台）订电动10系列，水平格就停在 25 m。印出的其余内容是 15 kW、理论输送量 21 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.1 m³、骨料 2 cm 及以下、1800 × 800 × 1200 mm、400 kg。名称里的“10”低于输送量。没有垂直数字可以附上。如果你必须写下量到的垂直升高，请把它写成现场事实，由邢台说明这一页是否仍然适用。带路径询盘 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。没有印价格。

heading.en: 23 MPa belongs here, not on Electric 15
heading.zh: 23 MPa 属于这里，不属于电动15

body.en: Electric 15 does not print pressure. Electric 40 also prints 23 MPa, at 45 kW and 21 m³/h, with a much longer distance pair. Same pressure is not the same order.
body.zh: 电动15不印压力。电动40也印 23 MPa，但是 45 kW、21 m³/h，距离长得多。压力相同不是同一张订单。

body.en: This is the smallest hopper figure on the trailer lists used here, and the 400 kg weight sits next to a frame of 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm.
body.zh: 这是此处使用的拖泵列表里最小的料斗数字，400 kg 旁边的外形是 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm。

body.en: Not printed. Send the site voltage and frequency yourself.
body.zh: 未印。请自行发送现场电压和频率。

question.zh: 可以写垂直 25 m 吗？

answer.en: The sheet labels 25 m as horizontal only.
answer.zh: 该页把 25 m 只标成水平。

question.en: Is B500S the same  compact order?
question.zh: B500S 是同一张紧凑订单吗？

answer.en: No. B500S-83D is 7.5 kW, 380 V, 5 m / 5 m and 280 kg.
